title: Screenshot reset launch option is not forwarded to the app under UI tests
reasoning: ScreenshotLaunchOptions defines EPILOGUE_SCREENSHOT_RESET as an app launch environment contract, but the UI test only forwards fixture and output environment values into XCUIApplication.launchEnvironment. The capture script starts xcodebuild with fixture/output variables and has no reset forwarding path, so EPILOGUE_SCREENSHOT_RESET=false can be visible to the test runner while the launched app still defaults resetData to true and clears data.
reproduction: Run the screenshot UI test through scripts/capture_screenshots.sh with EPILOGUE_SCREENSHOT_RESET=false and pre-existing simulator data. Because setUpWithError does not copy that variable into app.launchEnvironment, the app evaluates resetData with no environment override and clears existing Feed/Digest records.
recommendation: Forward EPILOGUE_SCREENSHOT_RESET from the test process into app.launchEnvironment, and have capture_screenshots.sh preserve/pass the variable alongside EPILOGUE_SCREENSHOT_FIXTURE_PATH.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included test never sets EPILOGUE_SCREENSHOT_RESET=false and does not assert preservation of pre-existing data.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a UI or launch-options test that sets EPILOGUE_SCREENSHOT_RESET=false, launches screenshot mode, and verifies existing data is not cleared.
minimumFixScope: Update EpilogueScreenshotTests.setUpWithError and scripts/capture_screenshots.sh to propagate EPILOGUE_SCREENSHOT_RESET.
